Here are 3 issues that looked open and are about Turbopack memory problems. I couldn't confirm their status from the issue pages, because GitHub API access was blocked in this session. The status comes from search-result snippets, so check each page before relying on it.

1. **[#92978](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/92978):** A stray parent lockfile makes Turbopack pick the wrong workspace root. Memory then grows without limit (one report reached 40+ GB), and module resolution retries forever on the first request. The reported workaround is to set `turbopack.root` explicitly.
2. **[#94432](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/94432):** Turbopack infers a parent directory as its root, which causes high memory pressure in `next dev`.
3. **[#97802](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/97802):** A Turbopack `next build` saturates 4 GB and stalls or runs out of memory. This is memory exhaustion during a build, not a leak that builds up over time.

None of these is a classic leak that grows over a long-running session.
